excerpts.text: Two new phosphate langbeinites, Rb2YbTi(PO4)3 and Rb2Yb0.32Ti1.68(PO4)3, investigated at 293 and 150 K. The rubidium ytterbium titanium phosphates Rb2YbTi(PO4)3, (I), and Rb2Yb(0.32)Ti(1.68)(PO4)3, (II), have been structurally characterized from X-ray data collected at both 293 and 150 K.

excerpts.text: Ternary rare-earth titanium antimonides RE2Ti(11-x)Sb(14+x) (RE = Sm, Gd, Tb, Yb). The isostructural rare-earth titanium antimonides RE 2Ti 11 - x Sb 14 + x ( RE = Sm, Gd, Tb, Yb) have been synthesized by arc-melting reactions of the elements.
